from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one court document relevant to the case cause matching task."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title/identifier of this court document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The 案由 (case cause/type) as explicitly stated in the document")
    legal_basis: str | None = Field(description="The primary law applied in the case (e.g., '行政诉讼法', '民法典')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_documents: list[CaseDocument]
